description: How much unused pension annual allowance from the last three tax years can be carried forward, and the total available this year. Use for 'how much can I put in my pension this year using carry forward'.

priorYearsUsed.description: Pension contributions in each of the last three tax years, oldest first, in pounds. Fewer than three is fine.
